characters.name: Fin
characters.voice_notes: Zei's best friend; gentle, bookish linguistics enthusiast training with the Bansunpei. Explains things at length with quiet enthusiasm.

characters.name: Bai
characters.voice_notes: Sharp, competitive, teasing; orphan who had to fend for herself, guarded but warming up. Zei's Minpentai rival turned sparring partner.

characters.name: Zei
characters.age: teen (final year of high school, about 17-18)
characters.voice_notes: Bright, intense, earnest; maths-minded Minpentai prodigy now studying cryptography; protagonist of the Dzego chapters. Proud but self-aware, eager to please his mentors.

characters.name: Den
characters.voice_notes: Cloaked Minpentai priest, High Council member of the Kungaupei (secret defense society). Soft-spoken, measured, mentor-like; lectures on cryptography and assumes compliance.

notes: No ambiguous attributions. D is Den throughout (introduced as 'the priest' at 9:55). 9:114 and similar device/SVG items carry no speech.
